parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a pen, made of plastic, cylindrical in shape, and designed to cover the writing tip. It is approximately 6 cm long and 1.2 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the pen tip from drying out and prevents ink leakage. It can also clip onto a pocket or notebook.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or attached to the pen body by pulling or snapping into place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of plastic, cylindrical, and approximately 8 cm long and 1.2 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: The base body houses the ink reservoir and writing tip, providing the main structure for gripping and writing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, but the internal ink refill may move slightly when replaced.
